title: The Anxious mother at the door
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：anxious　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anxious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the foreman wrote of ① an anxious mother at the door in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more anxious than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the anxious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most anxious mother at the door anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too anxious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the anxious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an anxious wait for news, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as anxious as the wait for news they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was anxious or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something anxious, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite anxious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the anxious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, year after year, she wrote of another anxious mother at the door in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ more anxious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most anxious wait for news in the whole site, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the anxious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 焦虑（前置定语 an anxious mother at the door：1955 年工头在施工单里记下的那件焦虑的母亲）
B. adj. 焦虑／渴望（比较级 more anxious than：文中两处，一处比门口的母亲，一处比预想）
C. adj. 焦虑／渴望（最高级 the most anxious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 焦虑（表语 too anxious to do：母亲觉得它太焦虑，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 渴望（前置定语 an anxious wait for news：叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的焦灼）
F. adj. 渴望（同级比较 as anxious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩等消息的焦灼相比）
G. adj. 渴望（后置定语 something anxious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 渴望（受程度副词修饰 quite anxious：那位工人的评价）

items.q: an anxious mother at the door
the most anxious mother at the door anybody
The most anxious wait for news in

answers.why: anxious 意为“焦虑”，1955 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件焦虑的母亲”，此处作前置定语 an anxious mother at the door。
anxious 意为“焦虑”，此处用比较级 more anxious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
anxious 意为“焦虑”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最焦虑的一件，故用最高级 the most anxious mother at the door。
anxious 意为“焦虑”，母亲认为这件东西“太焦虑了，谁也用不上”，too anxious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
anxious 意为“渴望”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩渴望的焦灼”，此处作前置定语 an anxious wait for news。
anxious 意为“渴望”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩等消息的焦灼一样渴望”，同级比较用 as anxious as。
anxious 意为“渴望”，施工单上那半行字要的是“渴望的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something anxious。
anxious 意为“渴望”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当渴望”，quite 修饰原级 anxious。
anxious 意为“渴望”，1965 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要渴望”，故用比较级 more anxious than。
anxious 意为“渴望”，母亲 1967 年说的是“整个工地里最渴望的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most anxious wait for news。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件焦虑的母亲。（an anxious mother at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更焦虑。（more anxious than …）
母亲觉得它太焦虑，谁也用不上。（too anxious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的焦灼。（an anxious wait for news）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩等消息的焦灼一样渴望。（as anxious as …）
到了 1962 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件渴望的东西。（something anxious）
answers: In 1955 the foreman wrote of an anxious mother at the door in the sheet.
Everybody said it was more anxious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too anxious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an anxious wait for news.
He said nobody would call it as anxious as the wait for news they had once had.
By 1962 the sheet asked for nothing but something anxious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 anxious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the foreman wrote of an anxious mother at the door in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most anxious mother at the door in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too anxious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an anxious wait for news, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite anxious, and everybody laughed.
The anxious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
